description: Agent Support Operations: submit first response records with the response-time commitments they answer to: the commitment with its reference, the default first response time in hours, a first response time per channel where one is set and any note on a known concentration of misses; each first response record with its id, the support ticket, its channel, the moment the ticket was opened, the moment the first response was recorded and the response time the record states in hours. The signed report gives the commitment and the records, each first response time worked out from the ticket timestamps against the commitment for its channel, each stated response time against the timestamps, and the missed commitments read for a concentration in one channel or one four-hour band of the opening time, and counts them, and names divergent first responses: a first response later than the commitment, a response time that does not recompute from the ticket timestamps, and missed commitments concentrated in one channel or hour band with no note, at least two misses with three quarters or more of them in one channel or band that holds a larger share of the misses than of the responses; then a first response recorded before its ticket opened and a ticket carrying two first response records, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No records, a channel with no commitment and no default, or a record with no opening or first response time to the minute leaves those points unverified. Channels match without case or punctuation with e-mail and live chat folded, response times count to the tenth of an hour between two moments that carry a time, and a stated time agrees when it matches to the tenth. This reads whether each first response meets the stated response commitment and its stated time recomputes. Verdict support_response_divergent, support_response_partial, support_response_unverified or support_response_consistent. POST /api/support-response-check. Reads the support records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it answers no customer, sends no message and opens, closes or changes no ticket, which stay with the support team, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Support Operations reads support operation records: ticket logs, first response records, resolution records, escalation records, promise records, performance records, backlog records and the support summary, each against the queue record, the stated response commitments, the customer confirmations, the stated escalation triggers, what the records show happened, the stated service commitments, the ticket list or the records beneath it. The family’s ground is support work already done, read across the whole queue: the DiligenceOps support brief reads one support conversation and lists the promises made in it, and the Agent Feedback family reads the loop around feedback on work, while this family checks whether the support operation’s records hold together across tickets. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-support-operations-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-support-operations/.
